description: Star of 5,000 K, 175 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

quotes.title: WASP-52
quotes.card: WASP-52, also named Anadolu, is a K-type main-sequence star about 570 light-years away in the constellation Pegasus.
quotes.introduction: It is older than the Sun at 10.7+1.9−4.5 billion years, but it has a similar fraction of heavy elements.
